question: Do I need to be pre-law to join?
answer: No. Membership is open to any MacEwan student taking at least one course this term, in any program, full-time, part-time or distance.

question: How do I join?
answer: Request to join MULC on Campus Labs with your MacEwan login, and an exec approves your request. The Join page walks you through each step.
